title: The Best Fence in a Corner | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
You have 12 units of fence with one bend, tucked into a corner. Most kids bend it into a square, but that's not the biggest area! Vantee shows a mirror trick that turns the corner into an octagon, checks it a second way, and gives you a straight-fence version to try yourself.
